description: This Kotlin source file defines the CatalogFragment class for an Android app, managing the display and filtering of product catalog items, including category filters and search functionality.

classes.name: CatalogFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment responsible for displaying product catalog with category filters and search functionality.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView and adapter, renders category filters, and sets up search listener.

methods.name: renderCategoryFilters
methods.description: Dynamically creates category filter chips based on available categories from repository.

methods.name: refreshProducts
methods.description: Filters products based on selected category and search query, then updates the product adapter.
